claims: The run exercised the real Harbor Trial, MyAgentHarness, Docker-backed tool execution, and verifier path.
The SQLite scheduler recovered completed jobs by idempotency key and did not re-run them.
All 100 synthetic tasks passed their verifier and left no managed Docker containers.
non_claims: This is not a Terminal-Bench or SWE benchmark score.
The scheduler active peak is 8; the independently sampled Docker running-container peak was 4 because container lifetimes were shorter than the sampling interval.
The experiment does not prove cross-host distributed scheduling or exactly-once external side effects.
Provider-reported cache-read share is not a full KV-cache hit-rate measurement.
